Signed by President Theodore Roosevelt Thursday, January 9, 1908

1 Canal Record 171, January 29, 1908

633428Executive Order 729 — Amending Canal Zone Penal Code Regarding Certain Misdemeanors1908President of the United States

Under authority vested in me by law, it is ordered:

That Title XIV of Act No. 14 of the Penal Code of the Laws of the Canal Zone be amended, effective January 15, 1908, by adding thereto the following section:

Section 293-A.

Sub-section 1. Every vagrant or person found within the Canal Zone without legitimate business or visible means of support; and

Sub-section 2. Every mendicant or habitual beggar found within the Canal Zone; and

Sub-section 3.
